note: The Repose verified on main@44d7fb9f: soil fertility does NOT reach settlement siting.  has five call sites (alchemy.rs:188, ground_lines_from at lib.rs:3479, one #[test], two lab metrics); SoilOrder/classify_soil appear nowhere in domains/settlement/ or domains/demography/; hornvale_terrain::fertility has two consumers, both lab metrics. The siting food term is hornvale_culture::fertility(biome_class), a BIOME class, not a soil order. Unrest, by contrast, reaches siting TWICE and in opposite directions: prospectivity() weights it 0.3 into the MINERAL supply axis (attracts), and hostility=unrest multiplies carrying capacity by (1-unrest) (repels). Anyone planning an andosol/soil-fertility measurement should read those two facts first.
